newsitem.title: USA: Photoelectron names Bojas, Belinko to posts.
newsitem.headline: Photoelectron names Bojas, Belinko to posts.

text.p: Photoelectron Corp said Tuesday it has named to new positions Gerald Bojas as chief financial officer and Allen Belinko as director of marketing and sales.

Bojas joins Photoelectron with 35 years of broad experience in financial management. Previously, he was chief financial officer and corporate controller and treasurer at MediSense Inc, a developer and manufacturer of blood glucose monitoring systems.
Belinko was vice president of sales and marketing at Nucletron Corp, a manufacturer of radiation equipment for the treatment of cancerous tumors.
Photoelectron Corp is a development stage medical device company founded in 1989.
